steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Oh, Director Muelsyse? Coming in for work this late at night?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ugh... *cough*, yes, there's always more to do.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Your work must be exhausting.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: And who are these two?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Some very important business partners of ours.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You don't recognize this one?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Uhh... Sorry, I'm not so good with heavily shrouded faces.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is the famous Originium theory scholar, Oripathy expert, and Catastrophe researcher—

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Oh... You! Your reputation precedes you! It's my lucky day, getting the chance to meet an amazing scientist like... you!

options: (This guy's never heard of me, has he?)

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We have urgent business to attend to, so we'll be heading up now. If we get the chance, we should have lunch together sometime, okay?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Right. Don't let me keep you...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Wait, I thought you looked familiar. Aren't you that expert in... uh...
...in the field of defensive materials.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Parvis...

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Rhine Lab has really expanded at an astonishing pace the last couple years, hasn't it?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: A consequence is that our new little friends still have much to learn.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Two directors here at the same time...? I-I... I'd better get back to work! Please excuse me!

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ahah.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You aren't going to tell them I'm back?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Forgive me, but my eyes aren't what they used to be. Have I met such a lovely Vouivre lady before?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: If you've nothing else for me, I'd better get home. An old man like me needs his sleep.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Right, Director Muelsyse. Don't forget the black bean tea you owe me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Phew... Saria, did he really just happen to be passing by?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's four in the morning.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Parvis normally would've gone home nine hours ago.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I knew it... He's not lining up behind either Ferdinand or Kristen until the last minute, when he's sure how the chips will fall.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: He's still calculating the odds, waiting to see.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I bet that even if Rhine Lab gets blasted to rubble, he'll walk out without a scratch.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: They've entered Rhine HQ.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Recon team, prepare to intercept.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Let's slow down a little.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I saw you fight Saria, and I'm pretty intrigued by your equipment.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Mind if I took a look?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Is this how you always greet your enemies before engaging, Rhodes Island elite operator?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not talking as a Rhodes Island elite operator there.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: As a mechanist, I respect all exceptional technology and its innovators—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Which is why I wanted to ask how you'd feel before I took that special-looking staff of yours.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You're a funny one, Mr. Mechanist.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I was only going to meet with Saria, but you and your boss... that Doctor certainly gave me a bigger surprise.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You know my name?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You've looked into me too, haven't you?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's the habit of our kind to gather up as much information as we can before a fight.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Your name is in Rhine HQ's database, Ms. Ho'olheyak.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But I don't buy that Ferdinand would hire a history scholar to hunt his coworkers down. That'd be silly, even for the impossible world of Columbian academia.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's my side gig.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You research history for a side gig?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Wrong.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm a historian. I'm just here to see a millennium-old prophecy come true.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Likewise, I believe our future is heading in a direction that'll lead us to certain hidden historical secrets—

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Just like you, I seek the truth.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Do you know how to find your scumbag boss, researcher?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: He should be in the control room right now.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: There's a vent around the corner. If you can get inside it, that's your quickest route to the control room.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You'll want to hurry, though.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We're about to have company.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: ...Officer.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: I knew you were on their side. You're weak-willed. You can't put your past with this criminal behind you.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: He's not a criminal yet, punk. You people don't have the power to convict. Not yet anyway.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: You're heading past the point of no return.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: But why? You're all so exceptional. Why destroy your future? Why... didn't she take my advice?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: This is about someone else, isn't it?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I can say this to you for her, again.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Because we know what we're fighting for.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: To protect certain people... To protect certain rules from being trampled by people like that scumbag director. We don't hesitate. Ever.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We aren't like you...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Probing all the sides before you pick one—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And even going so far as to ask that dumb question before a fight!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Urgh...!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Did you find out which way you're going?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I think so...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Hop to it, then.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I have a crossbow. You don't. Worry about yourself, not me.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Why aren't you going with her? I thought you came all this way to settle your score with him, too.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I've got my own weapon.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It's been a long time since we fought side-by-side.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: What are you talking about...? You mean back when we used to play those games?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Besides, I was the one always dragging you out to play.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Haha... thanks for that.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I really miss those days... I mean it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The elevator up ahead will take us straight to Control's office.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's safer if we take the fire exit in the back.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I know, but aren't we in a hurry?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It'll be faster if we head straight there, and run into less armed personnel along the way.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Wait, don't go over there—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Whoopsie. I forgot this area's monitored...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Doctor, it's time for plan B.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Intruders spotted!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Here! Over here!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Grab the intrud—Wait, Director?!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Hello, Reggie.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: What are you doing here...? No, you don't have clearance anymore. I can't let you go any further...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: When facing an intruder, hesitating only gives a chance for your enemy to strike.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Do you need me to teach you this all over again?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Shields up!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Prepare to stun! Target the intruder—Saria!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You pass, just barely.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Have the latest data been recorded?
Yes, they have.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Note the drones' positions.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Do not let the test subject's actions influence firsthand data collection.
Don't worry, Boss.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The firsthand data you want are right here in front of you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Elena.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'm glad you're safe.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've worked under you for so many years now. Reading the slightest change in your expression has become part of my job—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Your left eyebrow twitched ever so slightly. You're surprised.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Well, you are full of surprises.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's a relief to have you back—Those stupid new hires really need a fine researcher like you to discipline them.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You want me to be a team leader?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, not a team leader.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You see that key on the desk? Take it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You've more than proven your abilities. You don't need to be anyone's assistant anymore—Not mine, and not Dorothy's.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I want you to handle the next project as overseer.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: This key is a present I prepared for you. It's an all new... spacious laboratory. Your laboratory.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No matter what kind of experiments you want to run, both Rhine Lab and I will fully support you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wonderful.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Have you considered letting me take over as Energy Director?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: That is not out of the question.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You don't seem... particularly happy about my surprise.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's because no matter what kind of future you had in mind for me... my answer was always going to be 'no.'

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Set your staff down.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What are you afraid of? That I'm going to betray you and ruin the moment you see your bright future manifesting, right before your final victory?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I might just consider doing that.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I don't understand. I've given you so much...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I saw talent, diligence, and ambition in you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: All three are necessary to achieve success. All three qualities that also define me.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course you wouldn't understand.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If you actually thought so highly of me as you say—You'd have told me the truth behind the experiments.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You'd tell me how you disregard the safety of your test subjects, how you used me to keep tabs on Dorothy, and how when you finally have no more use for me, you'll wipe me out along with all the evidence of your crimes.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You think I'm some stupid little girl who listens to everything you say?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Even with Olivia's nudging, it took me till the moment you make your move for me to finally open my eyes!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You aren't ready, Elena. I was afraid you would be shaken, and here you are.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You've never trusted me.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You don't trust anyone, only yourself.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: So why should I trust you again... Why should I trust your promises now?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I've never given anyone more chances than I've given you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You know what? You're more like me than my own children.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I've poured much blood and sweat into you. Even now, if it's what you want, I would still welcome you at my side—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This is the last thing I'll ever ask of you—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Please shut up, Boss.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Take your 'present' and your fake sincerity and stay far away from me.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Starting today, I, Elena Urbica, am no longer your stupid little assistant or your pawn.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Ferdinand Clooney, you're fired.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Grab her! Get the rioter!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Hngh...

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director, are you alright?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Elena...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Stop... Stop looking at me... like you care about me at all.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It... disgusts me.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You say I don't understand you... but you've never truly understood me either.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Perhaps... I actually hesitated, worried in that brief moment just now.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I wasn't worried about the ruckus you were causing. I was worried about you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I really... didn't want to see things come to this.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Those words...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: *cough*... Right back at you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: *pant*...*pant*... What do we do? The Defense guys just keep coming and coming.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ferdinand's got all the sites covered. It doesn't matter how much of a fight Saria can put up. There's no way she can take on so many at once.

options: We're counting on you, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Me...? No way! I don't know how to fight.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: All the running around to dodge their attacks is exhausting already...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't you hear all my panting, Doctor?

options: Didn't you quite ingeniously cover for Saria just now?
As long as you stop deliberately wasting time...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You... You know?

options: Saria hasn't been to Rhine HQ in a while. How'd she remember which areas are monitored?
You've been blocking Saria's line of sight, intentionally or otherwise.
You've been pretty calm ever since you heard me guess this is where Control is.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I... Ahh!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: They almost got me...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor... You pulled me back? You... You'd still do that for me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Even though you've figured out that I might have other ideas?

options: You're free to have other ideas.
And I don't care where you stand.
I want you to help Saria.
This is for the benefit of both Rhodes Island and Rhine Lab.
This is for the safety of Columbia and all lands.
And this is for you, too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's the second time you've saved me now, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Let's call this my way of repaying the favor, then. I'll stand with you guys at least this once and help Saria get where she wants to go.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You hear me, water molecules?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Step up and give these nice people a little kissy, and wash away all the dust under our feet!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: The elf wavered.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: What a poor soul... She's always looking for some kind of promise of the future.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Who would willingly admit she and her race belong only to the past?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Can this Dr. {@nickname} really give her what Kristen can't?

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Ma'am, Saria has broken through the blockade.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Let her meet her old friend, then.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I still have other work to finish... Looks like this mechanist and I will just have to catch up next time.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: —That is, if he survives the power armor.
How long has it been since I was here?
One thousand four hundred and ninety-seven days.
Perhaps we were already enemies when we said our goodbyes.
Will we still be friends when we meet again?
You're back, Saria.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Hello, Kristen.
